text_sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च । शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥ १४-२७ ॥
itrans: brahmaNo hi pratiShThAhamamR^itasyAvyayasya cha . shAshvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikAntikasya cha .. 14-27 ..
translation: I am indeed the support of Brahman (Maha Lakshmi), the intelligent Prakriti and the undecaying immortalised souls after release, or the eternal Dharma and of the most exalted state of bliss.
